<hr data-start="1215" data-end="1218">
<h1 data-start="1220" data-end="1255">The biggest opportunity I see now</h1>
<p data-start="1257" data-end="1331">The senior's biggest weakness is actually <strong data-start="1299" data-end="1330">not that they lack features</strong>.</p>
<p data-start="1333" data-end="1366">It is that their evaluation asks:</p>
<blockquote data-start="1368" data-end="1406">
<p data-start="1370" data-end="1406">“Do users like our recommendations?”</p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="1408" data-end="1445">rather than rigorously demonstrating:</p>
<blockquote data-start="1447" data-end="1546">
<p data-start="1449" data-end="1546"><strong data-start="1449" data-end="1546">“Did our new recommendation mechanism improve a measurable outcome compared with a baseline?”</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="1548" data-end="1703">Their 82% and 4.3/5 numbers are useful, but there is no clear <strong data-start="1610" data-end="1653">before-vs-after attributable comparison</strong> in the PPT. <span class="contents" data-content-reference-start="1649" data-content-reference-end="1681"><span data-file-citation-group-identity="[[&quot;unknown&quot;,&quot;my_files&quot;,&quot;file_0000000035d08207a0a56ca1412ca5f7&quot;,1649,1681,null,null,0,546,557]]" data-file-citation-group-size="1" data-file-citation-primary-file-id="file_0000000035d08207a0a56ca1412ca5f7" data-file-citation-primary-library-provider="" data-file-citation-primary-source="my_files" class="relative inline-flex items-center select-none" type="button" aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-expanded="false" data-state="closed"><button type="button" class="ms-1 relative flex h-[25px] select-none items-center justify-center gap-1 rounded-xl px-2 text-[10px] leading-[13px] corner-superellipse/1.1 text-token-text-secondary! hover:text-token-text-primary! hover:bg-token-bg-secondary dark:bg-token-main-surface-secondary dark:hover:bg-token-bg-secondary bg-[#f4f4f4] "><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" aria-hidden="true" class="h-[16px] w-[16px] object-contain text-token-text-primary! flex-none icon-sm"><use href="/cdn/assets/sprites-core-0beb1f83.svg#58a0f5" fill="currentColor"></use></svg><p class="not-prose mt-0! mb-0! flex-auto truncate">SE Project-3</p></button></span></span></p>
<p data-start="1705" data-end="1740">And your teacher specifically says:</p>
<blockquote data-start="1742" data-end="1823">
<p data-start="1744" data-end="1823"><strong data-start="1744" data-end="1823">“The evaluation criterion should be measurable (and ideally attributable).”</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="1825" data-end="1877">So this can become a major part of <strong data-start="1860" data-end="1876">your project</strong>.</p>
<hr data-start="1879" data-end="1882">
<h1 data-start="1884" data-end="1947">I would make your 2026 project have these 3 NEW optimizations</h1>
<h3 data-start="1949" data-end="1982">1. Cold-start personalization</h3>
<p data-start="1984" data-end="2023"><strong data-start="1984" data-end="1996">Problem:</strong> A new user has no history.</p>
<p data-start="2025" data-end="2043"><strong data-start="2025" data-end="2043">Your solution:</strong></p>
<blockquote data-start="2045" data-end="2133">
<p data-start="2047" data-end="2133">“Select 3 movies you like”<br data-start="2073" data-end="2076">
→ generate initial taste profile<br data-start="2110" data-end="2113">
→ recommendations.</p>
</blockquote>
<h3 data-start="2135" data-end="2150">Measurable:</h3>
<p data-start="2152" data-end="2160">Compare:</p>
<p data-start="2162" data-end="2210"><strong data-start="2162" data-end="2175">Baseline:</strong> generic/movie-name recommendations</p>
<p data-start="2212" data-end="2215">vs.</p>
<p data-start="2217" data-end="2275"><strong data-start="2217" data-end="2233">Your system:</strong> recommendations after 3-movie onboarding.</p>
<p data-start="2277" data-end="2285">Measure:</p>
<ul data-start="2287" data-end="2393">
<li data-start="2287" data-end="2311">
<p data-start="2289" data-end="2311">Top-5 relevance rating</p>
</li>
<li data-start="2312" data-end="2357">
<p data-start="2314" data-end="2357">% users finding ≥3 relevant recommendations</p>
</li>
<li data-start="2358" data-end="2393">
<p data-start="2360" data-end="2393">Time to find a satisfactory movie</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="2395" data-end="2430">This is easy to test on classmates.</p>
<hr data-start="2432" data-end="2435">
<h1 data-start="2437" data-end="2473">2. Diversity + discovery optimizer</h1>
<p data-start="2475" data-end="2539">This is the one I'd make your <strong data-start="2505" data-end="2538">main algorithmic optimization</strong>.</p>
<p data-start="2541" data-end="2605">Senior system essentially emphasizes similarity/personalization.</p>
<p data-start="2607" data-end="2627">Your system can say:</p>
<blockquote data-start="2629" data-end="2684">
<p data-start="2631" data-end="2684"><strong data-start="2631" data-end="2684">Don't give five movies that are almost identical.</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="2686" data-end="2698">For example:</p>
<p data-start="2700" data-end="2711">User likes:</p>
<blockquote data-start="2713" data-end="2727">
<p data-start="2715" data-end="2727">Interstellar</p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="2729" data-end="2740">Instead of:</p>
<blockquote data-start="2742" data-end="2889">
<p data-start="2744" data-end="2889">Interstellar-like movie 1<br data-start="2769" data-end="2772">
Interstellar-like movie 2<br data-start="2799" data-end="2802">
Interstellar-like movie 3<br data-start="2829" data-end="2832">
Interstellar-like movie 4<br data-start="2859" data-end="2862">
Interstellar-like movie 5</p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="2891" data-end="2917">your reranker can produce:</p>
<blockquote data-start="2919" data-end="3023">
<p data-start="2921" data-end="2940">2 highly relevant</p>
<ul data-start="2943" data-end="3023">
<li data-start="2943" data-end="2971">
<p data-start="2945" data-end="2971">1 different but relevant</p>
</li>
<li data-start="2974" data-end="2992">
<p data-start="2976" data-end="2992">1 lesser-known</p>
</li>
<li data-start="2995" data-end="3023">
<p data-start="2997" data-end="3023">1 unexpected/serendipitous</p>
</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 data-start="3025" data-end="3037">Measure:</h3>
<p data-start="3039" data-end="3073"><strong data-start="3039" data-end="3073">Recommendation diversity score</strong></p>
<p data-start="3075" data-end="3078">AND</p>
<p data-start="3080" data-end="3107"><strong data-start="3080" data-end="3107">User-rated satisfaction</strong></p>
<p data-start="3109" data-end="3139">So you aren't merely claiming:</p>
<blockquote data-start="3141" data-end="3176">
<p data-start="3143" data-end="3176">“Our recommendations are better.”</p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="3178" data-end="3198">You can demonstrate:</p>
<blockquote data-start="3200" data-end="3282">
<p data-start="3202" data-end="3282">Baseline diversity = X<br data-start="3224" data-end="3227">
Optimized diversity = Y<br data-start="3252" data-end="3255">
User satisfaction = X → Y</p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="3284" data-end="3349">That fits your professor's evaluation requirement extremely well.</p>
<hr data-start="3351" data-end="3354">
<h1 data-start="3356" data-end="3406">3. Context-aware / “What do you want RIGHT NOW?”</h1>
<p data-start="3408" data-end="3461">This is probably the <strong data-start="3429" data-end="3460">best user-facing innovation</strong>.</p>
<p data-start="3463" data-end="3498">The senior's system primarily asks:</p>
<blockquote data-start="3500" data-end="3531">
<p data-start="3502" data-end="3531">What movies match your taste?</p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="3533" data-end="3550">Your system asks:</p>
<blockquote data-start="3552" data-end="3585">
<p data-start="3554" data-end="3585"><strong data-start="3554" data-end="3585">What do you want right now?</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="3587" data-end="3595">Example:</p>
<h3 data-start="3597" data-end="3623">User's long-term taste</h3>
<p data-start="3624" data-end="3649">Sci-fi + thriller + Nolan</p>
<h3 data-start="3651" data-end="3674">Current requirement</h3>
<blockquote data-start="3675" data-end="3722">
<p data-start="3677" data-end="3722">“I have 90 minutes and want something light.”</p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="3724" data-end="3749">The recommender combines:</p>
<p data-start="3751" data-end="3801"><strong data-start="3751" data-end="3801">Long-term taste + current intent + constraints</strong></p>
<p data-start="3803" data-end="3834">and produces the final ranking.</p>
<p data-start="3836" data-end="3852">Inputs could be:</p>
<ul data-start="3854" data-end="3922">
<li data-start="3854" data-end="3860">
<p data-start="3856" data-end="3860">Mood</p>
</li>
<li data-start="3861" data-end="3877">
<p data-start="3863" data-end="3877">Available time</p>
</li>
<li data-start="3878" data-end="3885">
<p data-start="3880" data-end="3885">Genre</p>
</li>
<li data-start="3886" data-end="3896">
<p data-start="3888" data-end="3896">Language</p>
</li>
<li data-start="3897" data-end="3910">
<p data-start="3899" data-end="3910">Release era</p>
</li>
<li data-start="3911" data-end="3922">
<p data-start="3913" data-end="3922">Intensity</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="3924" data-end="3985">This is very easy for your classmates to understand and test.</p>
<hr data-start="3987" data-end="3990">
<h1 data-start="3992" data-end="4030">And here's the REALLY important part</h1>
<p data-start="4032" data-end="4101">Don't evaluate the three optimizations separately with vague surveys.</p>
<p data-start="4103" data-end="4148">Build a <strong data-start="4111" data-end="4147">baseline vs optimized experiment</strong>.</p>
<h3 data-start="4150" data-end="4162">Baseline</h3>
<p data-start="4164" data-end="4189">Senior-style recommender:</p>
<blockquote data-start="4191" data-end="4221">
<p data-start="4193" data-end="4221">Personalization + similarity</p>
</blockquote>
<h3 data-start="4223" data-end="4244">Optimized version</h3>
<blockquote data-start="4246" data-end="4341">
<p data-start="4248" data-end="4265">Personalization</p>
<ul data-start="4268" data-end="4341">
<li data-start="4268" data-end="4293">
<p data-start="4270" data-end="4293">cold-start onboarding</p>
</li>
<li data-start="4296" data-end="4307">
<p data-start="4298" data-end="4307">context</p>
</li>
<li data-start="4310" data-end="4341">
<p data-start="4312" data-end="4341">diversity/discovery reranking</p>
</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="4343" data-end="4386">Then give both to, say, <strong data-start="4367" data-end="4385">30–50 students</strong>.</p>
<p data-start="4388" data-end="4430">Ask each student to perform the same task:</p>
<blockquote data-start="4432" data-end="4482">
<p data-start="4434" data-end="4482">“Find a movie you would actually watch tonight.”</p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="4484" data-end="4492">Measure:</p>
<div class="group TyagGW_tableContainer"><div tabindex="-1" class="TyagGW_tableWrapper flex flex-col-reverse w-fit"><table data-start="4494" data-end="4728" class="w-fit <p data-start="4730" data-end="4807"><strong data-start="4730" data-end="4807">THIS is much stronger than simply saying “82% liked our recommendations.”</strong></p>
<p data-start="4809" data-end="4956">It directly follows your teacher's requirement that evaluation should be measurable and ideally attributable. <span class="contents" data-content-reference-start="4897" data-content-reference-end="4929"><span data-file-citation-group-identity="[[&quot;unknown&quot;,&quot;my_files&quot;,&quot;file_0000000035d08207a0a56ca1412ca5f7&quot;,4897,4929,null,null,0,537,557]]" data-file-citation-group-size="1" data-file-citation-primary-file-id="file_0000000035d08207a0a56ca1412ca5f7" data-file-citation-primary-library-provider="" data-file-citation-primary-source="my_files" class="relative inline-flex items-center select-none" type="button" aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-expanded="false" data-state="closed"><button type="button" class="ms-1 relative flex h-[25px] select-none items-center justify-center gap-1 rounded-xl px-2 text-[10px] leading-[13px] corner-superellipse/1.1 text-token-text-secondary! hover:text-token-text-primary! hover:bg-token-bg-secondary dark:bg-token-main-surface-secondary dark:hover:bg-token-bg-secondary bg-[#f4f4f4] "><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" aria-hidden="true" class="h-[16px] w-[16px] object-contain text-token-text-primary! flex-none icon-sm"><use href="/cdn/assets/sprites-core-0beb1f83.svg#58a0f5" fill="currentColor"></use></svg><p class="not-prose mt-0! mb-0! flex-auto truncate">SE Project-3</p></button></span></span></p>
<hr data-start="4958" data-end="4961">
<h1 data-start="4963" data-end="5022">One more thing: the teacher's "local relevance" criterion</h1>
<p data-start="5024" data-end="5042">This is important.</p>
<p data-start="5044" data-end="5196">The course says projects should preferably have <strong data-start="5092" data-end="5157">local relevance, immediate applicability and near-term impact</strong>. <span class="contents" data-content-reference-start="5132" data-content-reference-end="5154"><span data-file-citation-group-identity="[[&quot;unknown&quot;,&quot;my_files&quot;,&quot;file_0000000035d08207a0a56ca1412ca5f7&quot;,5132,5154,null,null,0,null,null]]" data-file-citation-group-size="1" data-file-citation-primary-file-id="file_0000000035d08207a0a56ca1412ca5f7" data-file-citation-primary-library-provider="" data-file-citation-primary-source="my_files" class="relative inline-flex items-center select-none" type="button" aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-expanded="false" data-state="closed"><button type="button" class="ms-1 relative flex h-[25px] select-none items-center justify-center gap-1 rounded-xl px-2 text-[10px] leading-[13px] corner-superellipse/1.1 text-token-text-secondary! hover:text-token-text-primary! hover:bg-token-bg-secondary dark:bg-token-main-surface-secondary dark:hover:bg-token-bg-secondary bg-[#f4f4f4] "><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" aria-hidden="true" class="h-[16px] w-[16px] object-contain text-token-text-primary! flex-none icon-sm"><use href="/cdn/assets/sprites-core-0beb1f83.svg#58a0f5" fill="currentColor"></use></svg><p class="not-prose mt-0! mb-0! flex-auto truncate">SE Project-3</p></button></span></span></p>
<p data-start="5198" data-end="5314">So if you're still doing <strong data-start="5223" data-end="5267">a generic Netflix-like movie recommender</strong>, I'd be slightly worried about this criterion.</p>
<p data-start="5316" data-end="5365">You can fix it without changing the project type:</p>
<h3 data-start="5367" data-end="5418"><span role="text">Make it a <strong data-start="5381" data-end="5418">student-focused movie recommender</strong></span></h3>
<p data-start="5420" data-end="5432">For example:</p>
<blockquote data-start="5434" data-end="5502">
<p data-start="5436" data-end="5502"><strong data-start="5436" data-end="5502">“A context-aware movie discovery system for college students.”</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="5504" data-end="5558">Now your evaluation population is naturally available:</p>
<p data-start="5560" data-end="5634"><strong data-start="5560" data-end="5634">Thapar students → actual users → actual feedback → measurable results.</strong></p>
<p data-start="5636" data-end="5676">And constraints can be student-specific:</p>
<blockquote data-start="5678" data-end="5697">
<p data-start="5680" data-end="5697">“I have 2 hours.”</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote data-start="5699" data-end="5738">
<p data-start="5701" data-end="5738">“I want something light after exams.”</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote data-start="5740" data-end="5763">
<p data-start="5742" data-end="5763">“Hindi/English only.”</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote data-start="5765" data-end="5799">
<p data-start="5767" data-end="5799">“Available on platforms I have.”</p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="5801" data-end="5879">That gives you <strong data-start="5816" data-end="5878">local relevance + easy data collection + measurable impact</strong>.</p>
<hr data-start="5881" data-end="5884">
<h2 data-start="5886" data-end="5915">My final project structure</h2>
<p data-start="5917" data-end="5941">I would now pitch it as:</p>
<h3 data-start="5943" data-end="6010"><span role="text"><strong data-start="5947" data-end="6010">Context-Aware &amp; Diversity-Aware Movie Recommendation System</strong></span></h3>
<p data-start="6012" data-end="6090"><strong data-start="6012" data-end="6034">Existing baseline:</strong><br data-start="6034" data-end="6037">
Personalized + similarity-based movie recommendation.</p>
<p data-start="6092" data-end="6113"><strong data-start="6092" data-end="6113">Our improvements:</strong></p>
<ol data-start="6115" data-end="6293">
<li data-start="6115" data-end="6149">
<p data-start="6118" data-end="6149"><strong data-start="6118" data-end="6149">Cold-start taste onboarding</strong></p>
</li>
<li data-start="6150" data-end="6197">
<p data-start="6153" data-end="6197"><strong data-start="6153" data-end="6197">Context/constraint-aware recommendations</strong></p>
</li>
<li data-start="6198" data-end="6242">
<p data-start="6201" data-end="6242"><strong data-start="6201" data-end="6242">Diversity &amp; discovery-aware reranking</strong></p>
</li>
<li data-start="6243" data-end="6293">
<p data-start="6246" data-end="6293"><strong data-start="6246" data-end="6293">Controlled baseline-vs-optimized evaluation</strong></p>
</li>
</ol>
<p data-start="6295" data-end="6319">And the measurable goal:</p>
<blockquote data-start="6321" data-end="6453">
<p data-start="6323" data-end="6453"><strong data-start="6323" data-end="6453">Reduce time-to-choice while increasing recommendation relevance, satisfaction and diversity compared with the baseline system.</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="6455" data-end="6721">That is much more aligned with the professor's actual criteria than simply adding another chatbot or another API. The course explicitly prioritizes rapid delivery, mature engineering engines, scalability and measurable outcomes. <span class="contents" data-content-reference-start="6642" data-content-reference-end="6664"><span data-file-citation-group-identity="[[&quot;unknown&quot;,&quot;my_files&quot;,&quot;file_0000000035d08207a0a56ca1412ca5f7&quot;,6642,6664,null,null,0,null,null]]" data-file-citation-group-size="1" data-file-citation-primary-file-id="file_0000000035d08207a0a56ca1412ca5f7" data-file-citation-primary-library-provider="" data-file-citation-primary-source="my_files" class="relative inline-flex items-center select-none" type="button" aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-expanded="false" data-state="closed"><button type="button" class="ms-1 relative flex h-[25px] select-none items-center justify-center gap-1 rounded-xl px-2 text-[10px] leading-[13px] corner-superellipse/1.1 text-token-text-secondary! hover:text-token-text-primary! hover:bg-token-bg-secondary dark:bg-token-main-surface-secondary dark:hover:bg-token-bg-secondary bg-[#f4f4f4] "><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" aria-hidden="true" class="h-[16px] w-[16px] object-contain text-token-text-primary! flex-none icon-sm"><use href="/cdn/assets/sprites-core-0beb1f83.svg#58a0f5" fill="currentColor"></use></svg><p class="not-prose mt-0! mb-0! flex-auto truncate">SE Project-3</p></button></span></span></p>
<p data-start="6723" data-end="7077" data-is-last-node="" data-is-only-node=""><strong data-start="6723" data-end="6739">One caution:</strong> I would <em data-start="6748" data-end="6753">not</em> claim “existing Netflix/Prime recommenders don't do X.” Your PPT doesn't need that risky claim. Instead, frame your contribution as <strong data-start="6886" data-end="7022">optimizing a baseline recommender against identified recommender-system challenges and experimentally demonstrating the improvement.</strong> That is much easier to defend in front of the teacher.</p></div></div></div></div><div class="relative h-[60px] select-none"><div class="absolute h-[60px]" style="opacity: <h1 data-start="504" data-end="543">PPT — Movie Recommendation System 2.0</h1>
<h2 data-start="545" data-end="563">SLIDE 1 — TITLE</h2>
<h3 data-start="565" data-end="606"><span role="text"><strong data-start="569" data-end="606">SMART MOVIE RECOMMENDATION SYSTEM</strong></span></h3>
<h4 data-start="607" data-end="655"><span role="text"><em data-start="612" data-end="655">Personalized • Controllable • Group-Aware</em></span></h4>
<p data-start="657" data-end="682"><strong data-start="657" data-end="682">Team [Your Team Name]</strong></p>
<p data-start="684" data-end="706"><em data-start="684" data-end="706">Names + Roll Numbers</em></p>
<p data-start="708" data-end="823">A subtitle like this immediately differentiates you from the senior project without changing the fundamental topic.</p>
<hr data-start="825" data-end="828">
<h1 data-start="830" data-end="866">SLIDE 2 — PROBLEM STATEMENT / NEED</h1>
<h3 data-start="868" data-end="890"><span role="text"><strong data-start="872" data-end="890">Need Statement</strong></span></h3>
<ul data-start="892" data-end="1598">
<li data-start="892" data-end="1035">
<p data-start="894" data-end="1035">With thousands of movies across streaming platforms, users often face <strong data-start="964" data-end="983">choice overload</strong> and spend considerable time deciding what to watch.</p>
</li>
<li data-start="1037" data-end="1281">
<p data-start="1039" data-end="1281">Existing recommendation systems are highly effective at predicting <strong data-start="1106" data-end="1142">what an individual user may like</strong>, using signals such as viewing history, ratings, similar-user preferences and movie characteristics. <span class="contents" data-content-reference-start="1225" data-content-reference-end="1257"><span class="" data-state="closed"><span class="ms-1 inline-flex max-w-full items-center select-none relative top-[-0.094rem] translate-y-0.5 animate-[show_150ms_ease-in]" data-testid="webpage-citation-pill" style="width: 116px;"><a href="https://help.netflix.com/en/node/100639?utm_source=chatgpt.com" target="_blank" rel="noopener" alt="https://help.netflix.com/en/node/100639?utm_source=chatgpt.com" class="flex h-4.5 overflow-hidden rounded-xl pe-2 ps-1 text-[9px] font-medium transition-colors duration-150 ease-in-out text-token-text-secondary! bg-[#F4F4F4]! dark:bg-[#303030]! select-none" style="max-width: 116px;"><span class="relative start-0 bottom-0 flex h-full w-full items-center"><span class="flex h-4 w-full items-center justify-between" style="opacity: 1; transform: none;"><span class="flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-center gap-1"><span class="inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center overflow-hidden rounded-full"><img alt="" width="128" height="128" class="h-3 w-3 rounded-full" src="./env_files/favicons(4)"></span><span class="max-w-[15ch] grow truncate overflow-hidden text-center">Netflix Help Center</span></span><span class="-me-1 flex h-full items-center rounded-full px-1 text-[#8F8F8F]">+1</span></span></span></a></span></span></span></p>
</li>
<li data-start="1283" data-end="1451">
<p data-start="1285" data-end="1451">However, the decision is not always individual. Movies are frequently selected <strong data-start="1364" data-end="1401">with friends, couples or families</strong>, where different preferences have to be balanced.</p>
</li>
<li data-start="1453" data-end="1598">
<p data-start="1455" data-end="1598">Users may also want different recommendation goals at different times — <strong data-start="1527" data-end="1562">“something similar to my taste”</strong> versus <strong data-start="1570" data-end="1598">“show me something new.”</strong></p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 data-start="1600" data-end="1612"><span role="text"><strong data-start="1604" data-end="1612">Need</strong></span></h3>
<blockquote data-start="1614" data-end="1796">
<p data-start="1616" data-end="1796"><strong data-start="1616" data-end="1796">A recommendation system that does not only predict what users may like, but also lets them control the type of recommendations they want and helps groups reach a common choice.</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="1798" data-end="1957">This is stronger than the senior's original need statement, which primarily focused on too many movies and browsing time. <span class="contents" data-content-reference-start="1896" data-content-reference-end="1926"><span data-file-citation-group-identity="[[&quot;unknown&quot;,&quot;my_files&quot;,&quot;file_000000006f4082088e7e70c96c88d18e&quot;,1896,1926,null,null,0,12,20]]" data-file-citation-group-size="1" data-file-citation-primary-file-id="file_000000006f4082088e7e70c96c88d18e" data-file-citation-primary-library-provider="" data-file-citation-primary-source="my_files" class="relative inline-flex items-center select-none" type="button" aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-expanded="false" data-state="closed"><button type="button" class="ms-1 relative flex h-[25px] select-none items-center justify-center gap-1 rounded-xl px-2 text-[10px] leading-[13px] corner-superellipse/1.1 text-token-text-secondary! hover:text-token-text-primary! hover:bg-token-bg-secondary dark:bg-token-main-surface-secondary dark:hover:bg-token-bg-secondary bg-[#f4f4f4] "><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" aria-hidden="true" class="h-[16px] w-[16px] object-contain text-token-text-primary! flex-none icon-sm"><use href="/cdn/assets/sprites-core-0beb1f83.svg#58a0f5" fill="currentColor"></use></svg><p class="not-prose mt-0! mb-0! flex-auto truncate">SE Project-3</p></button></span></span></p>
<hr data-start="1959" data-end="1962">
<h1 data-start="1964" data-end="1991">SLIDE 3 — TARGET AUDIENCE</h1>
<h3 data-start="1993" data-end="2016"><span role="text"><strong data-start="1997" data-end="2016">Target Audience</strong></span></h3>
<h3 data-start="2018" data-end="2053"><span role="text">👥 <strong data-start="2025" data-end="2053">Friends &amp; Student Groups</strong></span></h3>
<p data-start="2054" data-end="2100">Groups trying to decide on one movie together.</p>
<h3 data-start="2102" data-end="2130"><span role="text">🎬 <strong data-start="2109" data-end="2130">Movie Enthusiasts</strong></span></h3>
<p data-start="2131" data-end="2191">Users who want both familiar favourites and new discoveries.</p>
<h3 data-start="2193" data-end="2228"><span role="text">👨‍👩‍👧 <strong data-start="2206" data-end="2228">Families &amp; Couples</strong></span></h3>
<p data-start="2229" data-end="2295">Users with different preferences who need a common recommendation.</p>
<h3 data-start="2297" data-end="2322"><span role="text">📱 <strong data-start="2304" data-end="2322">Casual Viewers</strong></span></h3>
<p data-start="2323" data-end="2389">Users who want a quick recommendation without repeatedly browsing.</p>
<h3 data-start="2391" data-end="2425">Optional small line at bottom:</h3>
<blockquote data-start="2427" data-end="2511">
<p data-start="2429" data-end="2511"><strong data-start="2429" data-end="2447">Primary users:</strong> Students and young adults who frequently watch movies socially.</p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="2513" data-end="2630">This is actually useful for your evaluation because <strong data-start="2565" data-end="2630">you can easily recruit your classmates/friends as real users.</strong></p>
<hr data-start="2632" data-end="2635">
<h1 data-start="2637" data-end="2656">SLIDE 4 — THE GAP</h1>
<p data-start="2658" data-end="2695">This is the <strong data-start="2670" data-end="2694">most important slide</strong>.</p>
<p data-start="2697" data-end="2976">Don't write “Netflix doesn't personalize” or “existing systems don't use context.” That's not defensible. Netflix explicitly uses viewing history, ratings, similar users, title information, time of day, language, device and viewing duration. <span class="contents" data-content-reference-start="2902" data-content-reference-end="2921"><span class="" data-state="closed"><span class="ms-1 inline-flex max-w-full items-center select-none relative top-[-0.094rem] translate-y-0.5 animate-[show_150ms_ease-in]" data-testid="webpage-citation-pill" style="width: 101px;"><a href="https://help.netflix.com/en/node/100639?utm_source=chatgpt.com" target="_blank" rel="noopener" alt="https://help.netflix.com/en/node/100639?utm_source=chatgpt.com" class="flex h-4.5 overflow-hidden rounded-xl pe-2 ps-1 text-[9px] font-medium transition-colors duration-150 ease-in-out text-token-text-secondary! bg-[#F4F4F4]! dark:bg-[#303030]! select-none" style="max-width: 101px;"><span class="relative start-0 bottom-0 flex h-full w-full items-center"><span class="flex h-4 w-full items-center justify-between overflow-hidden" style="opacity: 1; transform: none;"><span class="flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-center gap-1"><span class="inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center overflow-hidden rounded-full"><img alt="" width="128" height="128" class="h-3 w-3 rounded-full" src="./env_files/favicons(4)"></span><span class="max-w-[15ch] grow truncate overflow-hidden text-center">Netflix Help Center</span></span></span></span></a></span></span></span></p>
<p data-start="2978" data-end="2986">Instead:</p>
<h1 data-start="2988" data-end="3032"><span role="text"><strong data-start="2990" data-end="3032">Gaps in Current Recommendation Systems</strong></span></h1>
<h3 data-start="3034" data-end="3066"><span role="text">🎛️ <strong data-start="3042" data-end="3066">Limited User Control</strong></span></h3>
<p data-start="3067" data-end="3160">Most recommendation interfaces primarily present a ranked list based on predicted preference.</p>
<p data-start="3162" data-end="3266">Users have limited control over <strong data-start="3194" data-end="3242">how much they want familiarity vs. discovery</strong> in the recommendations.</p>
<h3 data-start="3268" data-end="3313"><span role="text">👥 <strong data-start="3275" data-end="3313">Individual-Centric Recommendations</strong></span></h3>
<p data-start="3314" data-end="3484">Personalized recommendations are generally built around an <strong data-start="3373" data-end="3395">individual profile</strong>, while a real viewing decision may involve multiple people with conflicting preferences.</p>
<h3 data-start="3486" data-end="3530"><span role="text">⚖️ <strong data-start="3493" data-end="3530">Relevance vs. Discovery Trade-off</strong></span></h3>
<p data-start="3531" data-end="3657">Maximizing similarity to previous preferences can produce highly relevant results, but may reduce <strong data-start="3629" data-end="3656">novelty and exploration</strong>.</p>
<hr data-start="3659" data-end="3662">
<h3 data-start="3664" data-end="3703">Bottom-line statement on the slide:</h3>
<blockquote data-start="3705" data-end="3881">
<p data-start="3707" data-end="3881"><strong data-start="3707" data-end="3881">The remaining challenge is not basic personalization — it is making recommendations more controllable, group-aware and adaptable to the user's desired level of discovery.</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="3883" data-end="3942">This is the statement I would defend if the professor asks:</p>
<blockquote data-start="3944" data-end="3998">
<p data-start="3946" data-end="3998"><em data-start="3946" data-end="3998">“But Netflix already does personalization, right?”</em></p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="4000" data-end="4012">You can say:</p>
<p data-start="4014" data-end="4192"><strong data-start="4014" data-end="4192">“Yes. We are not claiming that. We are specifically addressing what the user wants the recommender to optimize for, and extending the decision from an individual to a group.”</strong></p>
<p data-start="4194" data-end="4220">That's much more credible.</p>
<hr data-start="4222" data-end="4225">
<h1 data-start="4227" data-end="4251">SLIDE 5 — OUR SOLUTION</h1>
<h3 data-start="4253" data-end="4273"><span role="text"><strong data-start="4257" data-end="4273">Our Solution</strong></span></h3>
<h2 data-start="4275" data-end="4317"><span role="text">🎛️ <strong data-start="4282" data-end="4317">User-Controlled Recommendations</strong></span></h2>
<p data-start="4318" data-end="4366">Users select their desired recommendation style:</p>
<p data-start="4368" data-end="4400"><strong data-start="4368" data-end="4400">Familiar ←────────→ Discover</strong></p>
<p data-start="4402" data-end="4459">The ranking changes according to the selected preference.</p>
<hr data-start="4461" data-end="4464">
<h2 data-start="4466" data-end="4501"><span role="text">👥 <strong data-start="4472" data-end="4501">Group Recommendation Mode</strong></span></h2>
<p data-start="4502" data-end="4543">Multiple users provide their preferences.</p>
<p data-start="4545" data-end="4680">The system identifies movies that provide the <strong data-start="4591" data-end="4627">best overall group compatibility</strong>, rather than optimizing for only one person's taste.</p>
<hr data-start="4682" data-end="4685">
<h2 data-start="4687" data-end="4727"><span role="text">⚖️ <strong data-start="4693" data-end="4727">Balanced Recommendation Engine</strong></span></h2>
<p data-start="4728" data-end="4748">The system combines:</p>
<ul data-start="4750" data-end="4876">
<li data-start="4750" data-end="4771">
<p data-start="4752" data-end="4771">Personal preference</p>
</li>
<li data-start="4772" data-end="4790">
<p data-start="4774" data-end="4790">Movie similarity</p>
</li>
<li data-start="4791" data-end="4812">
<p data-start="4793" data-end="4812">Group compatibility</p>
</li>
<li data-start="4813" data-end="4834">
<p data-start="4815" data-end="4834">Novelty / diversity</p>
</li>
<li data-start="4835" data-end="4876">
<p data-start="4837" data-end="4876">User-selected recommendation preference</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="4878" data-end="4910">to generate a final ranked list.</p>
<hr data-start="4912" data-end="4915">
<h3 data-start="4917" data-end="4943"><span role="text"><strong data-start="4921" data-end="4943">Measurable Outcome</strong></span></h3>
<p data-start="4945" data-end="4972">Instead of simply claiming:</p>
<blockquote data-start="4974" data-end="5009">
<p data-start="4976" data-end="5009">“Our recommendations are better.”</p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="5011" data-end="5019">we test:</p>
<p data-start="5021" data-end="5101"><strong data-start="5021" data-end="5041">Individual mode:</strong><br data-start="5041" data-end="5044">
“How many recommended movies would you personally watch?”</p>
<p data-start="5103" data-end="5183"><strong data-start="5103" data-end="5118">Group mode:</strong><br data-start="5118" data-end="5121">
“How many group members agree to watch the recommended movie?”</p>
<p data-start="5185" data-end="5312"><strong data-start="5185" data-end="5206">Exploration mode:</strong><br data-start="5206" data-end="5209">
“Does increasing controllable discovery improve satisfaction without substantially reducing relevance?”</p>
<p data-start="5314" data-end="5622">This gives you a <strong data-start="5331" data-end="5360">real evaluation criterion</strong>, which your professor specifically emphasizes: the evaluation should be measurable and ideally attributable. Your course material explicitly gives examples such as measuring time reduction or user satisfaction rather than merely claiming that a solution works.</p>
<hr data-start="5624" data-end="5627">
<h1 data-start="5629" data-end="5660">SLIDE 6 — EVALUATION / IMPACT</h1>
<p data-start="5662" data-end="5739">I actually recommend adding this instead of immediately going to “Thank You.”</p>
<h3 data-start="5741" data-end="5777"><span role="text"><strong data-start="5745" data-end="5777">Evaluation &amp; Expected Impact</strong></span></h3>
<p data-start="5779" data-end="5842">We will conduct a small user study with students/friend groups.</p>
<h3 data-start="5844" data-end="5859"><span role="text"><strong data-start="5848" data-end="5859">Metrics</strong></span></h3>
<p data-start="5861" data-end="5892"><strong data-start="5861" data-end="5892">Recommendation Satisfaction</strong></p>
<blockquote data-start="5893" data-end="5940">
<p data-start="5895" data-end="5940">Average user rating of recommended movies / 5</p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="5942" data-end="5962"><strong data-start="5942" data-end="5962">Group Acceptance</strong></p>
<blockquote data-start="5963" data-end="6019">
<p data-start="5965" data-end="6019">% of group members willing to watch the selected movie</p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="6021" data-end="6038"><strong data-start="6021" data-end="6038">Decision Time</strong></p>
<blockquote data-start="6039" data-end="6075">
<p data-start="6041" data-end="6075">Time taken to reach a movie choice</p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="6077" data-end="6095"><strong data-start="6077" data-end="6095">Discovery Rate</strong></p>
<blockquote data-start="6096" data-end="6171">
<p data-start="6098" data-end="6171">% of users who accept a recommendation they had not previously considered</p>
</blockquote>
<h3 data-start="6173" data-end="6198"><span role="text"><strong data-start="6177" data-end="6198">Success Criterion</strong></span></h3>
<blockquote data-start="6200" data-end="6296">
<p data-start="6202" data-end="6296"><strong data-start="6202" data-end="6296">Improve decision-making speed and satisfaction while maintaining recommendation relevance.</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="6298" data-end="6583">This is particularly good because the senior project already had user feedback such as <strong data-start="6385" data-end="6449">82% perceived recommendation accuracy and 4.3/5 satisfaction</strong>, so your project can follow the same evaluation philosophy while measuring your <em data-start="6530" data-end="6535">new</em> features. <span class="contents" data-content-reference-start="6487" data-content-reference-end="6519"><span data-file-citation-group-identity="[[&quot;unknown&quot;,&quot;my_files&quot;,&quot;file_000000006f4082088e7e70c96c88d18e&quot;,6487,6519,null,null,0,546,557]]" data-file-citation-group-size="1" data-file-citation-primary-file-id="file_000000006f4082088e7e70c96c88d18e" data-file-citation-primary-library-provider="" data-file-citation-primary-source="my_files" class="relative inline-flex items-center select-none" type="button" aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-expanded="false" data-state="closed"><button type="button" class="ms-1 relative flex h-[25px] select-none items-center justify-center gap-1 rounded-xl px-2 text-[10px] leading-[13px] corner-superellipse/1.1 text-token-text-secondary! hover:text-token-text-primary! hover:bg-token-bg-secondary dark:bg-token-main-surface-secondary dark:hover:bg-token-bg-secondary bg-[#f4f4f4] "><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" aria-hidden="true" class="h-[16px] w-[16px] object-contain text-token-text-primary! flex-none icon-sm"><use href="/cdn/assets/sprites-core-0beb1f83.svg#58a0f5" fill="currentColor"></use></svg><p class="not-prose mt-0! mb-0! flex-auto truncate">SE Project-3</p></button></span></span></p>

<h3 data-start="7316" data-end="7360">The three gaps I'd officially commit to:</h3>
<p data-start="7362" data-end="7542"><strong data-start="7362" data-end="7419">1. Limited user control over recommendation objective</strong><br data-start="7419" data-end="7422">
<strong data-start="7422" data-end="7499">2. Individual-centric recommendation when decisions are often group-based</strong><br data-start="7499" data-end="7502">
<strong data-start="7502" data-end="7542">3. Relevance vs. discovery trade-off</strong></p>
<p data-start="7544" data-end="7909">These are substantially safer than the senior PPT's original gaps such as “OTT apps work in isolation” or “limited transparency,” because professional systems already have mature capabilities in personalization and related areas. Netflix, for example, documents extensive personalization and continuous feedback-based updating. <span class="contents" data-content-reference-start="7807" data-content-reference-end="7826"><span class="" data-state="closed"><span class="ms-1 inline-flex max-w-full items-center select-none relative top-[-0.094rem] translate-y-0.5 animate-[show_150ms_ease-in]" data-testid="webpage-citation-pill" style="width: 101px;"><a href="https://help.netflix.com/en/node/100639?utm_source=chatgpt.com" target="_blank" rel="noopener" alt="https://help.netflix.com/en/node/100639?utm_source=chatgpt.com" class="flex h-4.5 overflow-hidden rounded-xl pe-2 ps-1 text-[9px] font-medium transition-colors duration-150 ease-in-out text-token-text-secondary! bg-[#F4F4F4]! dark:bg-[#303030]! select-none" style="max-width: 101px;"><span class="relative start-0 bottom-0 flex h-full w-full items-center"><span class="flex h-4 w-full items-center justify-between overflow-hidden" style="opacity: 1; transform: none;"><span class="flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-center gap-1"><span class="inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center overflow-hidden rounded-full"><img alt="" width="128" height="128" class="h-3 w-3 rounded-full" src="./env_files/favicons(4)"></span><span class="max-w-[15ch] grow truncate overflow-hidden text-center">Netflix Help Center</span></span></span></span></a></span></span></span></p>
<p data-start="7911" data-end="8206">And your project still remains <strong data-start="7942" data-end="7990">very close to the senior project technically</strong>: you're still building a movie recommender, using the same general recommendation-engine concept, but you're adding a <strong data-start="8109" data-end="8135">new optimization layer</strong> rather than trying to invent an entirely new recommendation algorithm.</p>
<p data-start="8208" data-end="8441" data-is-last-node="" data-is-only-node=""><strong data-start="8208" data-end="8243">One important presentation tip:</strong> don't call these “problems that Netflix cannot solve.” Call them <strong data-start="8309" data-end="8386">“opportunities/gaps in the user experience and recommendation objective.”</strong> That wording is much harder for a professor to attack.</p></div></div></div></div><div class="relative h-[60px] select-none"><div class="absolute h-[60px]" style="opacity: 1;"><button class="not-prose group/footnote Their pages 3–5 make this very concrete: three modules, exact workflow, measurable targets, multi-tenant scalability and 4×2-week CI/CD sprints. <span class="contents" data-content-reference-start="370" data-content-reference-end="400"><span data-file-citation-group-identity="[[&quot;unknown&quot;,&quot;my_files&quot;,&quot;file_00000000174c82089cd3681c1049082a&quot;,370,400,null,null,0,32,48],[&quot;unknown&quot;,&quot;my_files&quot;,&quot;file_00000000174c82089cd3681c1049082a&quot;,401,431,null,null,0,51,71],[&quot;unknown&quot;,&quot;my_files&quot;,&quot;file_00000000174c82089cd3681c1049082a&quot;,432,462,null,null,0,74,95]]" data-file-citation-group-size="3" data-file-citation-primary-file-id="file_00000000174c82089cd3681c1049082a" data-file-citation-primary-library-provider="" data-file-citation-primary-source="my_files" class="relative inline-flex items-center select-none" type="button" aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-expanded="false" data-state="closed"><button type="button" class="ms-1 relative flex h-[25px] select-none items-center justify-center gap-1 rounded-xl px-2 text-[10px] leading-[13px] corner-superellipse/1.1 text-token-text-secondary! hover:text-token-text-primary! hover:bg-token-bg-secondary dark:bg-token-main-surface-secondary dark:hover:bg-token-bg-secondary bg-[#f4f4f4] "><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" aria-hidden="true" class="h-[16px] w-[16px] object-contain text-token-text-primary! flex-none icon-sm"><use href="/cdn/assets/sprites-core-0beb1f83.svg#58a0f5" fill="currentColor"></use></svg><p class="not-prose mt-0! mb-0! flex-auto truncate">SOFTWARE ENGINEERING — GROUP PR… +2</p></button></span></span> <span class="contents" data-content-reference-start="401" data-content-reference-end="431"></span> <span class="contents" data-content-reference-start="432" data-content-reference-end="462"></span></p>
<p data-start="485" data-end="673">Your PPT already does <strong data-start="507" data-end="553">problem → target audience → gap → solution</strong> well. <span class="contents" data-content-reference-start="539" data-content-reference-end="569"><span data-file-citation-group-identity="[[&quot;unknown&quot;,&quot;my_files&quot;,&quot;file_00000000c7708211b5f1811f7f166213&quot;,539,569,null,null,1,14,22],[&quot;unknown&quot;,&quot;my_files&quot;,&quot;file_00000000c7708211b5f1811f7f166213&quot;,570,600,null,null,1,25,45],[&quot;unknown&quot;,&quot;my_files&quot;,&quot;file_00000000c7708211b5f1811f7f166213&quot;,601,631,null,null,1,48,77]]" data-file-citation-group-size="3" data-file-citation-primary-file-id="file_00000000c7708211b5f1811f7f166213" data-file-citation-primary-library-provider="" data-file-citation-primary-source="my_files" class="relative inline-flex items-center select-none" type="button" aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-expanded="false" data-state="closed"><button type="button" class="ms-1 relative flex h-[25px] select-none items-center justify-center gap-1 rounded-xl px-2 text-[10px] leading-[13px] corner-superellipse/1.1 text-token-text-secondary! hover:text-token-text-primary! hover:bg-token-bg-secondary dark:bg-token-main-surface-secondary dark:hover:bg-token-bg-secondary bg-[#f4f4f4] "><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" aria-hidden="true" class="h-[16px] w-[16px] object-contain text-token-text-primary! flex-none icon-sm"><use href="/cdn/assets/sprites-core-0beb1f83.svg#58a0f5" fill="currentColor"></use></svg><p class="not-prose mt-0! mb-0! flex-auto truncate">THE PROBLEM +2</p></button></span></span> <span class="contents" data-content-reference-start="570" data-content-reference-end="600"></span> <span class="contents" data-content-reference-start="601" data-content-reference-end="631"></span></p>
<h3 data-start="675" data-end="703">What YOUR PPT is missing</h3>
<p data-start="705" data-end="751">I would add <strong data-start="717" data-end="729">one page</strong> after “Our Solution”:</p>
<h1 data-start="753" data-end="786"><span role="text"><strong data-start="755" data-end="786">Implementation &amp; Validation</strong></span></h1>
<h3 data-start="788" data-end="826"><span role="text">🛠️ <strong data-start="796" data-end="826">Core Recommendation Engine</strong></span></h3>
<p data-start="827" data-end="963"><strong data-start="827" data-end="884">Content-Based Filtering + Weighted Preference Scoring</strong><br data-start="884" data-end="887">
Uses movie characteristics and user preferences to generate recommendations.</p>
<h3 data-start="965" data-end="996"><span role="text">🔄 <strong data-start="972" data-end="996">How We Will Build It</strong></span></h3>
<p data-start="997" data-end="1143"><strong data-start="997" data-end="1143">User Preferences → Recommendation Engine → Familiar/Discover Adjustment → Group Preference Integration → Final Recommendations → User Feedback</strong></p>
<h3 data-start="1145" data-end="1183"><span role="text">📊 <strong data-start="1152" data-end="1183">How We Will Measure Success</strong></span></h3>
<ul data-start="1184" data-end="1452">
<li data-start="1184" data-end="1238">
<p data-start="1186" data-end="1238"><strong data-start="1186" data-end="1203">Decision time</strong> — how quickly users select a movie</p>
</li>
<li data-start="1239" data-end="1324">
<p data-start="1241" data-end="1324"><strong data-start="1241" data-end="1270">Recommendation acceptance</strong> — how many recommendations users would actually watch</p>
</li>
<li data-start="1325" data-end="1366">
<p data-start="1327" data-end="1366"><strong data-start="1327" data-end="1348">User satisfaction</strong> — rating out of 5</p>
</li>
<li data-start="1367" data-end="1452">
<p data-start="1369" data-end="1452"><strong data-start="1369" data-end="1391">Group satisfaction</strong> — how many group members agree with the final recommendation</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 data-start="1454" data-end="1476"><span role="text">🚀 <strong data-start="1461" data-end="1476">Scalability</strong></span></h3>
<p data-start="1477" data-end="1624">The system can be extended to <strong data-start="1507" data-end="1573">more users, a larger movie catalogue and different group sizes</strong> without changing the core recommendation approach.</p>
<h3 data-start="1626" data-end="1652"><span role="text">🔄 <strong data-start="1633" data-end="1652">Rapid Iteration</strong></span></h3>
<p data-start="1653" data-end="1727">We will follow <strong data-start="1668" data-end="1719">Build → Test → Deploy → User Feedback → Improve</strong> cycles.</p>
<hr data-start="1729" data-end="1732">
<h3 data-start="1734" data-end="1767">One thing I would ALSO change</h3>
<p data-start="1769" data-end="1801">Your current solution page says:</p>
<blockquote data-start="1803" data-end="1829">
<p data-start="1805" data-end="1829">“Reducing browsing time”</p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="1831" data-end="1915">but doesn't yet say <strong data-start="1851" data-end="1876">how you'll prove that</strong>. <span class="contents" data-content-reference-start="1831" data-content-reference-end="1862"><span data-file-citation-group-identity="[[&quot;unknown&quot;,&quot;my_files&quot;,&quot;file_00000000c7708211b5f1811f7f166213&quot;,1831,1862,null,null,1,95,105]]" data-file-citation-group-size="1" data-file-citation-primary-file-id="file_00000000c7708211b5f1811f7f166213" data-file-citation-primary-library-provider="" data-file-citation-primary-source="my_files" class="relative inline-flex items-center select-none" type="button" aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-expanded="false" data-state="closed"><button type="button" class="ms-1 relative flex h-[25px] select-none items-center justify-center gap-1 rounded-xl px-2 text-[10px] leading-[13px] corner-superellipse/1.1 text-token-text-secondary! hover:text-token-text-primary! hover:bg-token-bg-secondary dark:bg-token-main-surface-secondary dark:hover:bg-token-bg-secondary bg-[#f4f4f4] "><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" aria-hidden="true" class="h-[16px] w-[16px] object-contain text-token-text-primary! flex-none icon-sm"><use href="/cdn/assets/sprites-core-0beb1f83.svg#58a0f5" fill="currentColor"></use></svg><p class="not-prose mt-0! mb-0! flex-auto truncate">THE PROBLEM</p></button></span></span></p>
<p data-start="1917" data-end="1930">Change it to:</p>
<blockquote data-start="1932" data-end="2106">
<p data-start="1934" data-end="2106"><strong data-start="1934" data-end="1961">Reducing Browsing Time:</strong><br data-start="1961" data-end="1964">

</blockquote>
<p data-start="2108" data-end="2305">That one sentence makes it much more like your friend's A+ PPT, where they explicitly define measurable outcomes such as order-entry time and parsing accuracy. <span class="contents" data-content-reference-start="2215" data-content-reference-end="2245"><span data-file-citation-group-identity="[[&quot;unknown&quot;,&quot;my_files&quot;,&quot;file_00000000174c82089cd3681c1049082a&quot;,2215,2245,null,null,0,83,95]]" data-file-citation-group-size="1" data-file-citation-primary-file-id="file_00000000174c82089cd3681c1049082a" data-file-citation-primary-library-provider="" data-file-citation-primary-source="my_files" class="relative inline-flex items-center select-none" type="button" aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-expanded="false" data-state="closed"><button type="button" class="ms-1 relative flex h-[25px] select-none items-center justify-center gap-1 rounded-xl px-2 text-[10px] leading-[13px] corner-superellipse/1.1 text-token-text-secondary! hover:text-token-text-primary! hover:bg-token-bg-secondary dark:bg-token-main-surface-secondary dark:hover:bg-token-bg-secondary bg-[#f4f4f4] "><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" aria-hidden="true" class="h-[16px] w-[16px] object-contain text-token-text-primary! flex-none icon-sm"><use href="/cdn/assets/sprites-core-0beb1f83.svg#58a0f5" fill="currentColor"></use></svg><p class="not-prose mt-0! mb-0! flex-auto truncate">SOFTWARE ENGINEERING — GROUP PR…</p></button></span></span></p>
<p data-start="2307" data-end="2507" data-is-last-node="" data-is-only-node=""><strong data-start="2307" data-end="2340">So don't add random features.</strong> Your project idea is already fine. <h3 data-start="1510" data-end="1543"><span role="text"><strong data-start="1514" data-end="1543">Who This Actually Affects</strong></span></h3>

Users who spend time browsing through many movies before deciding what to watch.</p>
<p data-start="1652" data-end="1758"><strong data-start="1652" data-end="1680">Friends &amp; Student Groups</strong><br data-start="1680" data-end="1683">
Groups where different preferences make it difficult to agree on one movie.</p>
<p data-start="1760" data-end="1845"><strong data-start="1760" data-end="1772">Families</strong><br data-start="1772" data-end="1775">
Family members with different tastes who need a common recommendation.</p>

<p data-start="1864" data-end="1985"><strong data-start="1864" data-end="1985">A simple movie decision becomes difficult when preferences differ or users want something beyond their usual choices.</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="1987" data-end="2221">This matches your friend's stakeholder-based approach much better than simply listing “Movie Enthusiasts / Casual Viewers.” Their slide explicitly identifies people and their <strong data-start="2162" data-end="2182">daily pain point</strong>. <span class="contents" data-content-reference-start="2134" data-content-reference-end="2164"><span data-file-citation-group-identity="[[&quot;unknown&quot;,&quot;my_files&quot;,&quot;file_00000000af7c8211a5e81a04158d884b&quot;,2134,2164,null,null,0,14,29]]" data-file-citation-group-size="1" data-file-citation-primary-file-id="file_00000000af7c8211a5e81a04158d884b" data-file-citation-primary-library-provider="" data-file-citation-primary-source="my_files" class="relative inline-flex items-center select-none" type="button" aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-expanded="false" data-state="closed"><button type="button" class="ms-1 relative flex h-[25px] select-none items-center justify-center gap-1 rounded-xl px-2 text-[10px] leading-[13px] corner-superellipse/1.1 text-token-text-secondary! hover:text-token-text-primary! hover:bg-token-bg-secondary dark:bg-token-main-surface-secondary dark:hover:bg-token-bg-secondary bg-[#f4f4f4] "><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" aria-hidden="true" class="h-[16px] w-[16px] object-contain text-token-text-primary! flex-none icon-sm"><use href="/cdn/assets/sprites-core-0beb1f83.svg#58a0f5" fill="currentColor"></use></svg><p class="not-prose mt-0! mb-0! flex-auto truncate">SOFTWARE ENGINEERING — GROUP PR…</p></button></span></span></p>

Present them as <strong data-start="2382" data-end="2400">system modules</strong>, just like your friend's “Three Core Modules.” <span class="contents" data-content-reference-start="2391" data-content-reference-end="2421"><span data-file-citation-group-identity="[[&quot;unknown&quot;,&quot;my_files&quot;,&quot;file_00000000af7c8211a5e81a04158d884b&quot;,2391,2421,null,null,0,31,48]]" data-file-citation-group-size="1" data-file-citation-primary-file-id="file_00000000af7c8211a5e81a04158d884b" data-file-citation-primary-library-provider="" data-file-citation-primary-source="my_files" class="relative inline-flex items-center select-none" type="button" aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-expanded="false" data-state="closed"><button type="button" class="ms-1 relative flex h-[25px] select-none items-center justify-center gap-1 rounded-xl px-2 text-[10px] leading-[13px] corner-superellipse/1.1 text-token-text-secondary! hover:text-token-text-primary! hover:bg-token-bg-secondary dark:bg-token-main-surface-secondary dark:hover:bg-token-bg-secondary bg-[#f4f4f4] "><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" aria-hidden="true" class="h-[16px] w-[16px] object-contain text-token-text-primary! flex-none icon-sm"><use href="/cdn/assets/sprites-core-0beb1f83.svg#58a0f5" fill="currentColor"></use></svg><p class="not-prose mt-0! mb-0! flex-auto truncate">SOFTWARE ENGINEERING — GROUP PR…</p></button></span></span></p>
<h3 data-start="2487" data-end="2526"><span role="text"><strong data-start="2491" data-end="2526">Our Solution: Four Core Modules</strong></span></h3>
<h3 data-start="2528" data-end="2558"><span role="text">🎛️ <strong data-start="2536" data-end="2558">Preference Control</strong></span></h3>
<p data-start="2559" data-end="2663">Users choose between <strong data-start="2580" data-end="2603">Familiar ↔ Discover</strong> recommendations according to what they want at that moment.</p>
<h3 data-start="2665" data-end="2696"><span role="text">👥 <strong data-start="2672" data-end="2696">Group Recommendation</strong></span></h3>
<p data-start="2697" data-end="2800">Multiple users enter their preferences and the system generates recommendations suitable for the group.</p>
<h3 data-start="2802" data-end="2837"><span role="text">⚖️ <strong data-start="2809" data-end="2837">Recommendation &amp; Ranking</strong></span></h3>
<p data-start="2838" data-end="2930">Movies are ranked using <strong data-start="2862" data-end="2900">preference, similarity and variety</strong> rather than similarity alone.</p>
<h3 data-start="2932" data-end="2969"><span role="text">🔍 <strong data-start="2939" data-end="2969">Recommendation Explanation</strong></span></h3>
<p data-start="2970" data-end="3037">The system displays the <strong data-start="2994" data-end="3036">key factors behind each recommendation</strong>.</p>
<h3 data-start="3039" data-end="3065">Bottom differentiator:</h3>
<blockquote data-start="3067" data-end="3163">
<p data-start="3069" data-end="3163"><strong data-start="3069" data-end="3163">The differentiator: User-controlled recommendations for both individual and group viewing.</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="3165" data-end="3235">This is much closer to the engineering framing of your friend's slide.</p>

<h3 data-start="3394" data-end="3414"><span role="text"><strong data-start="3398" data-end="3414">How It Works</strong></span></h3>
<p data-start="3416" data-end="3512"><strong data-start="3416" data-end="3441">1 — Enter Preferences</strong><br data-start="3441" data-end="3444">
User selects genres/preferences and chooses <strong data-start="3488" data-end="3511">Familiar ↔ Discover</strong>.</p>
<p data-start="3514" data-end="3515">↓</p>
<p data-start="3517" data-end="3661"><strong data-start="3517" data-end="3553">2 — Build Recommendation Profile</strong><br data-start="3553" data-end="3556">
The system processes user preferences and, if required, combines preferences from multiple group members.</p>
<p data-start="3663" data-end="3664">↓</p>
<p data-start="3666" data-end="3782"><strong data-start="3666" data-end="3685">3 — Rank Movies</strong><br data-start="3685" data-end="3688">
The recommendation engine calculates suitability using <strong data-start="3743" data-end="3781">preference, similarity and variety</strong>.</p>
<p data-start="3784" data-end="3785">↓</p>
<p data-start="3787" data-end="3883"><strong data-start="3787" data-end="3815">4 — Show Recommendations</strong><br data-start="3815" data-end="3818">
Top movies are displayed with <strong data-start="3848" data-end="3882">reasons for the recommendation</strong>.</p>
<p data-start="3885" data-end="3892">Bottom:</p>
<blockquote data-start="3894" data-end="3954">
<p data-start="3896" data-end="3954"><strong data-start="3896" data-end="3954">User Selection → Feedback → Recommendation Improvement</strong></p>
</blockquote>

<h1 data-start="4407" data-end="4427"><span role="text"><strong data-start="4409" data-end="4427">Why This Works</strong></span></h1>
<h3 data-start="4429" data-end="4463"><span role="text"><strong data-start="4433" data-end="4463">Grounded in a Real Problem</strong></span></h3>
<p data-start="4464" data-end="4691">Existing systems primarily focus on predicting individual preferences, while movie decisions can involve <strong data-start="4569" data-end="4607">groups and different viewing goals</strong>. Your current PPT already establishes this. <span class="contents" data-content-reference-start="4560" data-content-reference-end="4590"><span data-file-citation-group-identity="[[&quot;unknown&quot;,&quot;my_files&quot;,&quot;file_00000000010c8208a5bfaa9624d22433&quot;,4560,4590,null,null,1,14,22]]" data-file-citation-group-size="1" data-file-citation-primary-file-id="file_00000000010c8208a5bfaa9624d22433" data-file-citation-primary-library-provider="" data-file-citation-primary-source="my_files" class="relative inline-flex items-center select-none" type="button" aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-expanded="false" data-state="closed"><button type="button" class="ms-1 relative flex h-[25px] select-none items-center justify-center gap-1 rounded-xl px-2 text-[10px] leading-[13px] corner-superellipse/1.1 text-token-text-secondary! hover:text-token-text-primary! hover:bg-token-bg-secondary dark:bg-token-main-surface-secondary dark:hover:bg-token-bg-secondary bg-[#f4f4f4] "><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" aria-hidden="true" class="h-[16px] w-[16px] object-contain text-token-text-primary! flex-none icon-sm"><use href="/cdn/assets/sprites-core-0beb1f83.svg#58a0f5" fill="currentColor"></use></svg><p class="not-prose mt-0! mb-0! flex-auto truncate">THE PROBLEM</p></button></span></span></p>
<h3 data-start="4693" data-end="4726"><span role="text"><strong data-start="4697" data-end="4726">How We'll Measure Success</strong></span></h3>
<p data-start="4728" data-end="4796"><strong data-start="4728" data-end="4747">↓ Decision Time</strong><br data-start="4747" data-end="4750">
Average time taken by users to select a movie.</p>
<p data-start="4798" data-end="4895"><strong data-start="4798" data-end="4829">↑ Recommendation Acceptance</strong><br data-start="4829" data-end="4832">
Percentage of recommended movies users would consider watching.</p>
<p data-start="4897" data-end="4963"><strong data-start="4897" data-end="4920">↑ User Satisfaction</strong><br data-start="4920" data-end="4923">
User rating of recommendation relevance.</p>
<p data-start="4965" data-end="5049"><strong data-start="4965" data-end="4989">↑ Group Satisfaction</strong><br data-start="4989" data-end="4992">
Whether group members agree with the recommended choices.</p>
<hr data-start="5051" data-end="5054">
<h3 data-start="5056" data-end="5096"><span role="text"><strong data-start="5060" data-end="5096">Built for More Than One Scenario</strong></span></h3>
<p data-start="5098" data-end="5133"><strong data-start="5098" data-end="5133">Individual → Friends → Families</strong></p>
<p data-start="5135" data-end="5223">The same recommendation approach can support different numbers of users and preferences.</p>
<hr data-start="5225" data-end="5228">
<h3 data-start="5230" data-end="5259"><span role="text"><strong data-start="5234" data-end="5259">Iterative Development</strong></span></h3>
<p data-start="5261" data-end="5307"><strong data-start="5261" data-end="5307">Build → Test → Deploy → Feedback → Improve</strong></p>
<hr data-start="5309" data-end="5312">
<h3 data-start="5314" data-end="5333"><span role="text">🚀 <strong data-start="5321" data-end="5333">Scalable</strong></span></h3>
<blockquote data-start="5334" data-end="5446">
<p data-start="5336" data-end="5446">The system can be extended to more users, movies and groups without changing the core recommendation approach.</p>
</blockquote>
<hr data-start="5448" data-end="5451">
<h1 data-start="5453" data-end="5478"><span role="text"><strong data-start="5455" data-end="5478">SLIDE 6 — THANK YOU</strong></span></h1>
<p data-start="5480" data-end="5545">Keep your existing thank-you style, but make the ending stronger:</p>
<h3 data-start="5547" data-end="5564"><span role="text"><strong data-start="5551" data-end="5564">THANK YOU</strong></span></h3>
<blockquote data-start="5566" data-end="5617">
<p data-start="5568" data-end="5617"><strong data-start="5568" data-end="5617">Preference-Driven Movie Recommendation System</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote data-start="5619" data-end="5692">
<p data-start="5621" data-end="5692"><em data-start="5621" data-end="5692">Making movie decisions simpler, more flexible and more collaborative.</em></p>
</blockquote>

<p data-start="215" data-end="344">Their system uses a recommendation system to analyze user preferences and recommend movies. <span class="contents" data-content-reference-start="302" data-content-reference-end="332"><span data-file-citation-group-identity="[[&quot;unknown&quot;,&quot;my_files&quot;,&quot;file_0000000038788211b322f4c1258e7ae2&quot;,302,332,null,null,0,16,20]]" data-file-citation-group-size="1" data-file-citation-primary-file-id="file_0000000038788211b322f4c1258e7ae2" data-file-citation-primary-library-provider="" data-file-citation-primary-source="my_files" class="relative inline-flex items-center select-none" type="button" aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-expanded="false" data-state="closed"><button type="button" class="ms-1 relative flex h-[25px] select-none items-center justify-center gap-1 rounded-xl px-2 text-[10px] leading-[13px] corner-superellipse/1.1 text-token-text-secondary! hover:text-token-text-primary! hover:bg-token-bg-secondary dark:bg-token-main-surface-secondary dark:hover:bg-token-bg-secondary bg-[#f4f4f4] "><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" aria-hidden="true" class="h-[16px] w-[16px] object-contain text-token-text-primary! flex-none icon-sm"><use href="/cdn/assets/sprites-core-0beb1f83.svg#58a0f5" fill="currentColor"></use></svg><p class="not-prose mt-0! mb-0! flex-auto truncate">SE Project-3</p></button></span></span></p>
</li>
<li data-start="345" data-end="503">
<p data-start="347" data-end="503">They mention <strong data-start="360" data-end="403">content-based / collaborative filtering</strong> as part of their recommendation approach/future hybrid model. <span class="contents" data-content-reference-start="454" data-content-reference-end="486"><span data-file-citation-group-identity="[[&quot;unknown&quot;,&quot;my_files&quot;,&quot;file_0000000038788211b322f4c1258e7ae2&quot;,454,486,null,null,0,629,640]]" data-file-citation-group-size="1" data-file-citation-primary-file-id="file_0000000038788211b322f4c1258e7ae2" data-file-citation-primary-library-provider="" data-file-citation-primary-source="my_files" class="relative inline-flex items-center select-none" type="button" aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-expanded="false" data-state="closed"><button type="button" class="ms-1 relative flex h-[25px] select-none items-center justify-center gap-1 rounded-xl px-2 text-[10px] leading-[13px] corner-superellipse/1.1 text-token-text-secondary! hover:text-token-text-primary! hover:bg-token-bg-secondary dark:bg-token-main-surface-secondary dark:hover:bg-token-bg-secondary bg-[#f4f4f4] "><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" aria-hidden="true" class="h-[16px] w-[16px] object-contain text-token-text-primary! flex-none icon-sm"><use href="/cdn/assets/sprites-core-0beb1f83.svg#58a0f5" fill="currentColor"></use></svg><p class="not-prose mt-0! mb-0! flex-auto truncate">SE Project-3</p></button></span></span></p>
</li>
<li data-start="504" data-end="602">
<p data-start="506" data-end="602">They also explicitly discuss <strong data-start="535" data-end="563">AI-based personalization</strong>. <span class="contents" data-content-reference-start="548" data-content-reference-end="580"><span data-file-citation-group-identity="[[&quot;unknown&quot;,&quot;my_files&quot;,&quot;file_0000000038788211b322f4c1258e7ae2&quot;,548,580,null,null,0,575,593]]" data-file-citation-group-size="1" data-file-citation-primary-file-id="file_0000000038788211b322f4c1258e7ae2" data-file-citation-primary-library-provider="" data-file-citation-primary-source="my_files" class="relative inline-flex items-center select-none" type="button" aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-expanded="false" data-state="closed"><button type="button" class="ms-1 relative flex h-[25px] select-none items-center justify-center gap-1 rounded-xl px-2 text-[10px] leading-[13px] corner-superellipse/1.1 text-token-text-secondary! hover:text-token-text-primary! hover:bg-token-bg-secondary dark:bg-token-main-surface-secondary dark:hover:bg-token-bg-secondary bg-[#f4f4f4] "><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" aria-hidden="true" class="h-[16px] w-[16px] object-contain text-token-text-primary! flex-none icon-sm"><use href="/cdn/assets/sprites-core-0beb1f83.svg#58a0f5" fill="currentColor"></use></svg><p class="not-prose mt-0! mb-0! flex-auto truncate">SE Project-3</p></button></span></span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 data-start="604" data-end="633">But important distinction</h3>
<p data-start="635" data-end="902">Their <strong data-start="641" data-end="671">current implemented system</strong> appears to use ML for movie recommendation/similarity. Their future prospects include making the recommendation model more advanced by combining collaborative filtering + content-based models. <span class="contents" data-content-reference-start="843" data-content-reference-end="875"><span data-file-citation-group-identity="[[&quot;unknown&quot;,&quot;my_files&quot;,&quot;file_0000000038788211b322f4c1258e7ae2&quot;,843,875,null,null,0,629,640]]" data-file-citation-group-size="1" data-file-citation-primary-file-id="file_0000000038788211b322f4c1258e7ae2" data-file-citation-primary-library-provider="" data-file-citation-primary-source="my_files" class="relative inline-flex items-center select-none" type="button" aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-expanded="false" data-state="closed"><button type="button" class="ms-1 relative flex h-[25px] select-none items-center justify-center gap-1 rounded-xl px-2 text-[10px] leading-[13px] corner-superellipse/1.1 text-token-text-secondary! hover:text-token-text-primary! hover:bg-token-bg-secondary dark:bg-token-main-surface-secondary dark:hover:bg-token-bg-secondary bg-[#f4f4f4] "><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" aria-hidden="true" class="h-[16px] w-[16px] object-contain text-token-text-primary! flex-none icon-sm"><use href="/cdn/assets/sprites-core-0beb1f83.svg#58a0f5" fill="currentColor"></use></svg><p class="not-prose mt-0! mb-0! flex-auto truncate">SE Project-3</p></button></span></span></p>
<p data-start="904" data-end="948">For <strong data-start="908" data-end="924">your project</strong>, if we're implementing:</p>
<blockquote data-start="949" data-end="1016">
<p data-start="951" data-end="1016">Preference Control → Group Recommendation → Ranking → Explanation</p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="1018" data-end="1058">you <strong data-start="1022" data-end="1057">do not automatically need AI/ML</strong>.</p>
<p data-start="1060" data-end="1100">You can build a working prototype using:</p>
<ul data-start="1101" data-end="1219">
<li data-start="1101" data-end="1116">
<p data-start="1103" data-end="1116">movie dataset</p>
</li>
<li data-start="1117" data-end="1144">
<p data-start="1119" data-end="1144">genre/preference matching</p>
</li>
<li data-start="1145" data-end="1164">
<p data-start="1147" data-end="1164">cosine similarity</p>
</li>
<li data-start="1165" data-end="1188">
<p data-start="1167" data-end="1188">scoring/ranking rules</p>
</li>
<li data-start="1189" data-end="1219">
<p data-start="1191" data-end="1219">group preference aggregation</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="1221" data-end="1313">That would be a <strong data-start="1237" data-end="1279">recommendation system using algorithms</strong>, but not necessarily an ML model.</p>

<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>Write a&nbsp;solution to find the IDs of the users who visited without making any transactions and the number of times they made these types of visits.</p>
<p>Return the result table sorted in&nbsp;<strong>any order</strong>.</p>
<p>The&nbsp;result format is in the following example.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Example 1:</strong></p>
<pre class="my-2 max-w-full overflow-x-auto rounded-xl bg-(--theme-user-msg-text)/10 p-3 text-(--theme-user-msg-text)"><code class="text-sm">Input: 
Visits
+----------+-------------+
| visit_id | customer_id |
+----------+-------------+
| 1        | 23          |
| 2        | 9           |
| 4        | 30          |
| 5        | 54          |
| 6        | 96          |
| 7        | 54          |
| 8        | 54          |
+----------+-------------+
Transactions
+----------------+----------+--------+
| transaction_id | visit_id | amount |
+----------------+----------+--------+
| 2              | 5        | 310    |
| 3              | 5        | 300    |
| 9              | 5        | 200    |
| 12             | 1        | 910    |
| 13             | 2        | 970    |
+----------------+----------+--------+
Output: 
+-------------+----------------+
| customer_id | count_no_trans |
+-------------+----------------+
| 54          | 2              |
| 30          | 1              |
| 96          | 1              |
+-------------+----------------+
Explanation: 
Customer with id = 23 visited the mall once and made one transaction during the visit with id = 12.
Customer with id = 9 visited the mall once and made one transaction during the visit with id = 13.
Customer with id = 30 visited the mall once and did not make any transactions.
Customer with id = 54 visited the mall three times. During 2 visits they did not make any transactions, and during one visit they made 3 transactions.
Customer with id = 96 visited the mall once and did not make any transactions.
As we can see, users with IDs 30 and 96 visited the mall one time without making any transactions. Also, user 54 visited the mall twice and did not make any transactions.

<p data-start="406" data-end="492">Replace only the value after <code data-start="435" data-end="438">=</code> with the <strong data-start="448" data-end="473">API Read Access Token</strong> you got from TMDB.</p>
<p data-start="494" data-end="629">TMDB officially recommends the Read Access Token as a Bearer token in the <code data-start="568" data-end="583">Authorization</code> header. <span class="contents" data-content-reference-start="592" data-content-reference-end="611"><span class="" data-state="closed"><span class="ms-1 inline-flex max-w-full items-center select-none relative top-[-0.094rem] translate-y-0.5 animate-[show_150ms_ease-in]" data-testid="webpage-citation-pill" style="width: 101px;"><a href="https://developer.themoviedb.org/docs/authentication-application?utm_source=chatgpt.com" target="_blank" rel="noopener" alt="https://developer.themoviedb.org/docs/authentication-application?utm_source=chatgpt.com" class="flex h-4.5 overflow-hidden rounded-xl pe-2 ps-1 text-[9px] font-medium transition-colors duration-150 ease-in-out text-token-text-secondary! bg-[#F4F4F4]! dark:bg-[#303030]! select-none" style="max-width: 101px;"><span class="relative start-0 bottom-0 flex h-full w-full items-center"><span class="flex h-4 w-full items-center justify-between overflow-hidden" style="opacity: 1; transform: none;"><span class="flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-center gap-1"><span class="inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center overflow-hidden rounded-full"><img alt="" width="128" height="128" class="h-3 w-3 rounded-full" src="./env_files/favicons(5)"></span><span class="max-w-[15ch] grow truncate overflow-hidden text-center">The Movie Database (TMDB)</span></span></span></span></a></span></span></span></p>
<p data-start="631" data-end="654">Save and close Notepad.</p>
